purpose: company region (광역 지자체) for the company form and the personalized candidate filter; one source for Spring (validation and the /api/company/regions list), React (select options) and FastAPI (candidate filter)
decision: 2026-10-03 user decision (IMP-019 region part, rule change): plan A excludes only programs whose jurisdiction_name is a different 광역 지자체 than the company region; central ministries, public bodies, unmapped jurisdictions and nationwide programs stay. Plan 가: the company region is one of the 16 standard names below (data has one merged 전남광주통합특별시 instead of 광주광역시 and 전라남도)
alias_rule: legacy free-text values are converted once (migration V11) when the value, with whitespace removed, starts with an alias; the longest matching alias wins; a value matching no alias becomes NULL and is counted
jurisdiction_rule: jurisdiction_name values mapped here are local governments; a city / county / district jurisdiction is added here with its upper 광역 region (none exist in the 2026-10-03 data: 42 distinct values = 16 광역 + 26 central)
national_rule: central ministries and public bodies are kept for every company region (nationwide target); listed for audit only, the filter never needs them
unmapped_rule: fail open: a jurisdiction_name that is neither in jurisdiction_regions nor in national_jurisdictions is kept, because excluding an unknown owner could hide a valid nationwide program; new values are reviewed and added here
filter_rule: with a standard company region the candidate filter excludes jurisdiction_name IN (jurisdiction_regions keys whose region differs); the applied conditions record the region and the excluded jurisdictions; a company region outside regions (legacy free text) is unapplied with reason region_not_standard
query_rule: query jurisdictions (Natural Filter) are intersected with the allowed set (company region jurisdictions + national + unmapped); if nothing remains the result is CONDITION_CONFLICT with conflict.kind region (company_region, query_jurisdictions) and no candidates; a query naming only central ministries is never a conflict
known_gaps: a program for several regions owned by one 광역 is excluded for companies of the other regions (2026-10-03: 1 program, [부산ㆍ울산ㆍ경남] 동남 정보보호클러스터, owned by 경상남도; Backlog IMP-030)
central-ministry programs whose title names one region are kept (2026-10-03: 63 of 384 not-closed central programs; IMP-019 follow-up)
